findings.what: 7895 Odds API credit(s) were spent since 2026-10-22T17:36:40Z that no stored snapshot records
findings.why: the API's own balance fell by more than the snapshots add up to. A pull whose snapshot never reached main (a lost push, a crash after the request) is money the daily cap cannot see and a pull the next run may buy again. Largest gaps: 2026-10-22T17:50:55Z −7745 (data/ncaaf/2026-10-22/props-player/1750.json.gz); 2026-10-23T17:28:10Z −150 (data/nfl/2026-10-23/gamelines/1728.json.gz)

credits.basis: The API's own remaining-quota header, recorded on a paid pull as `credits_remaining`. ⛔ NOT a plan size and NOT budget.py's projection.
credits.stands_down_first: A props pull is priced per game, so it is the first thing that cannot afford to run; the bulk game-lines pull is the cheapest and stands down last.
